evidence.note: Sol verified type=castleguard, baseType=hostilefu and all 11 exact dialogue occurrences.
Sol verified type=castleguardbasic, baseType=villageguard and all 11 exact dialogue occurrences.
Sol verified type=castleguardlookout, baseType=hostilelookout and all 11 exact dialogue occurrences.
Sol verified type=castleroyalguard, baseType=hostilefu and all 11 exact dialogue occurrences.
Sol verified type=fuevilchef, baseType=hostilefu and all 22 exact dialogue occurrences.

Sol read loadDialog/queryDialog/speciesDialog/sayToEntity/getDialog. Speaker species first, target species second, default fallbacks; helper selects/tags/says text but does not establish active hail/attack trigger for these types.
Exact Glitch NPC brushes: tiles363 castleguard,364 castleguardlookout,365 castleroyalguard. No per-instance config in these brushes.
Tiled objects have npc=glitch,typeName=castleguardbasic,parameters={}; friendlycastleguard objects are distinct.
Only castleguard/castleroyalguard target brushes found; not castleguardlookout. Guard-specific dialogue at a different config path does not prove precedence over type hail.
Sol decoded fuevilchef type/spawner references. Cultist human,apex skath,bunker human; bandit parameters omit npcSpecies. Static definitions only, no live trigger claim.
hostilefu parent base and behavior hostileguard absent. Basic vanilla villageguard and lookout hostilelookout absent. Four precursormob review IDs remain machine identifiers, excluded.

corrections_to_delivery: Only three types directly inherit hostilefu. The README blanket claim was incorrect; basic inherits villageguard and lookout inherits hostilelookout.
No castleguardlookout typeName exists in the two cited Dungeoneer files. Its verified static brush is glitchundergroundencounter /tiles/364/brush/0/1.

Dungeoneer guard dialogue is at parameters/scriptConfig/guard/dialog, whereas target type dialogue is scriptConfig/dialog. Without the missing consumer, precedence or suppression of target hail is not proven.
Bandit asteroid spawner does not declare npcSpecies in its parameters; the delivery claim skath is unsupported there. Apex room5 separately declares skath.

limitations: All66 EN/TR variants and exact occurrence source pointers read. Five complete direct NPC definitions inspected; all66fields are direct FU source,not inferred from missing vanilla.

Direct inheritance: castleguard,castleroyalguard,fuevilchef→hostilefu; castleguardbasic→villageguard; castleguardlookout→hostilelookout. The initial Sol README blanket hostilefu claim was wrong and corrected in review evidence.

FU hostilefu and villageguard patch inspected. Vanilla base,villageguard,hostilelookout and hostileguard behavior implementation absent. Actual hail/attack invocation for these types and live triggers remain unverified; selection helper alone is not a trigger proof.

Glitch underground brushes link three guard types. Glitch mission Tiled objects link basic; friendlycastleguard is distinct. Two Dungeoneer files link guard/royalguard,not lookout. Delivery lookout references there were rejected.
Dungeoneer instance guard/dialog/hail differs from type scriptConfig/dialog/hail. Without the consumer, override precedence or target-default suppression is not established.
Chef cultist NPC human,apex spawner/NPC skath,bunker spawner human. Bandit spawner has fuevilchef but omits npcSpecies in parameters; the delivery skath claim is unsupported there.

Glitch prefix intensity/contempt,idiot-sandwich compounds,raw emphasis and Floran natural-s hiss corrected. Source beligerant misspelling translated by belligerent context; Exacerbated increased-anger wording retained without pretending a source repair.
All31distinct full replies are LOCKED; no generic emotion root lock or unchanged-English preserve permission added. Existing terms,format/TM exceptions and all20028previous catalog fields unchanged.
Four related precursormob review items are technical behavior/personality/reaction IDs,not player dialogue; unchanged and excluded.

Live activation,font/layout,LQA NOT TESTED. No online Steam upload,game installation or shutdown. This completes the requested five new rounds only after all publication gates; no further package dispatch.
